title: fibonacci-vortex-core: φ-modulated vortex core with Fibonacci hierarchy
description:
A vortex model with distance-dependent circulation:

Γ(r) = Γ₀ · Σ F_k · φ^(−(k+1) r/r_c) / Σ F_k

Properties:

  • Γ(0) = Γ₀ (exact, for any K)
  • Γ(∞) = 0 (exact, exponentially)
  • Γ(φr)/Γ(r) ≈ 1/φ for K ≥ 5 (numerical, verified)
  • Monotonicity: Γ(r) strictly decreasing on [0, ∞)

In contrast to classical vortex models (Rankine, Lamb-Oseen, Gaussian), the circulation here is a Fibonacci-weighted φ-exponential sum, giving a self-similar decay of circulation with distance.

The repository includes:

  • reference implementation in Python (NumPy only)
  • pytest tests for all properties (Γ(0)=Γ₀, decay, φ-scaling, velocity, comparison with classical models, Zeckendorf address, axis orientation)
  • comparison helpers with Rankine and Lamb-Oseen
  • matplotlib example for visualisation

Status: research prototype (TRL 3). Not a validated physical theory. Numerical properties only; formula is a mathematical construct, not derived from physical equations.
